name: data_08003C32
description: data byte 0x56 ('V') inside the signature/version block; start of an 11-byte build/version string at 0x08003C33

name: data_08003C52
description: data byte 0x52 ('R') inside the signature block; start of a 16-byte ID/version string at 0x08003C53

name: dap_read_reg
description: Low-level DAP DP/AP register read; dispatches to bit-bang SWD path (DAT_20001022==1) or SPI/JTAG path, returns value in *out and an ack/status byte

name: dap_read_reg_checked
description: DAP register read wrapper that issues a RDBUFF/error read (dap_read_rdbuff) when the read ack is not OK

name: dap_write_reg
description: Low-level DAP DP/AP register write; builds the request+32-bit data frame and drives the bit-bang SWD or SPI/JTAG backend

name: dap_write_reg_checked
description: DAP register write wrapper that issues a RDBUFF/error read when the write ack is not OK

name: dap_check_ctrl_stat
description: Reads DP CTRL/STAT and maps sticky error/overrun bits (STICKYERR/STICKYORUN/WDATAERR) to ST-Link error status codes 0x18-0x1A

name: dap_read_rdbuff
description: Completes a posted DAP read by reading DP RDBUFF (reg 0/3) and discarding the result; used to flush/finish transactions

name: dap_finish_transfer
description: Finishes a DAP transfer: checks CTRL/STAT, reads RDBUFF, and overrides the status with the error code unless it was a wait/fault code

name: jtag_shift_short
description: Raw JTAG transfer (SPI/DMA path only; returns 8 in bit-bang mode): loads IR=0xF then shifts a packed DR pattern built from two argument words

name: jtag_shift_ir_dr
description: Raw JTAG IR/DR shift of a caller-selected bit length (SPI/DMA path); modes 1 and 2 shift 32/36-bit DR after IR=0xF, else returns error 6

name: dap_ack_to_status
description: Translates a raw SWD/JTAG ack+parity result word into an ST-Link status byte (0x80 OK, 0x09/0x10-0x17 wait/fault/parity, 0x06 proto error)

name: dap_identify_ap
description: Reads the access-port/debug identification and sets *is_known=1 if it matches a table of known Cortex-M part IDs (0x44A,0x44E,0x474,...,0x4B2)

name: dap_read_part_id
description: In bit-bang mode, reads DP IDCODE (switching to AP bank via dap_select_dpbank) and extracts the part-number field; returns 0x43 if unsupported

name: target_connect
description: Connects/initialises the debug target: resets per-AP CSW/TAR/IDCODE caches, powers up the DAP, reads IDCODE, detects the ROM table and sets AP state

name: dap_power_up_debug
description: Powers up the debug domain by writing DP CTRL/STAT CDBGPWRUPREQ/CSYSPWRUPREQ (0x50000000) and polling for the ack bits

name: rom_read_component_id
description: Reads a ROM-table/component PID from registers at base+0xFE0/0xFE4/0xFE8 and assembles the component/part number and class

name: target_scan_rom_table
description: Scans the ROM table / debug AP of the current and other access ports to detect the core, handling connection-loss and auto re-detection

name: target_part_is_special
description: (uncertain) Returns 1 if the detected ROM/part id (DAT_20001078) is one of a special set (0x1E,0x27,0x28,0x32,0x49A) used to vary the SWD line-reset sequence

name: target_slot_check
description: Validates an AP/slot index against the active-slot table (DAT_20001358); returns 0x80 if valid, 0x1D (bad index) otherwise

name: target_select_ap
description: Selects/configures an access port: reads its IDR/CFG/BASE registers, caches the ROM base in the per-AP table, and sets the AP CSW defaults

name: target_disconnect
description: Disconnects the target: tears down the bit-bang/SPI backend and invalidates the per-AP CSW caches

name: dap_select_ap
description: Writes DP SELECT to select the requested access port and AP register bank, caching the current value in DAT_2000102c

name: dap_select_dpbank
description: Writes DP SELECT to change only the DP bank-select nibble (e.g. to reach TARGETID/DLCR), preserving the current AP selection

name: mem_ap_set_csw
description: Configures the MEM-AP CSW for a given access size/mode (0=8b,1=16b,2=32b,3=no-increment) when it differs from the cached value

name: target_drive_nrst
description: Drives the target nRST line via GPIOB (through gpio helper): assert low, pulse with delay, or release high depending on the mode

name: mem_read_word
description: Convenience wrapper reading a single 32-bit word from target memory via mem_read_32

name: cortexm_write_reg_verify
description: (uncertain) Sets MEM-AP TAR to DHCSR region, writes a Cortex-M debug register and reads it back (DAT_2000107c) to verify the written value

name: cortexm_mem_ap_access_retry
description: (uncertain) Sets up the MEM-AP at the DHCSR address and performs a debug-register access, retrying up to 10 times while polling a ready bit

name: dap_get_last_rw_status
description: Reads the last read/write transfer status/value (GETLASTRWSTATUS): returns cached DAT_2000107c in bit-bang mode or re-reads it via the SPI path

name: cortexm_read_all_regs
description: Reads all Cortex-M core registers (0x15 or 0x21 regs depending on mode) via DCRSR/DCRDR into the DAT_200010A0 register array

name: cortexm_check_halted
description: Reads DHCSR and sets *halted=1 if the core is halted (S_HALT bit set)

name: dwt_set_watchpoint
description: Programs a DWT comparator/mask/function (data watchpoint) from indexed register-address tables for the given comparator index

name: fpb_set_breakpoint
description: Programs an FPB flash-patch comparator (FP_COMPx) for a hardware breakpoint and enables FP_CTRL (0xE0002000)

name: cortexm_reset_and_halt
description: Resets and halts the core: sets DEMCR VC_CORERESET, issues AIRCR SYSRESETREQ (0x05FA0001), polls for reset/halt and leaves the core halted

name: cortexm_step
description: Single-steps the core by writing DHCSR 0xA05F0005 and polling DHCSR S_REGRDY/S_HALT

name: cortexm_halt
description: Halts the core by writing DHCSR 0xA05F0003 and polling until S_HALT is set (with timeout)

name: mem_read_32
description: Reads a block of 32-bit words from target memory via the MEM-AP with auto-incrementing TAR

name: mem_read_32_noinc
description: Reads count 32-bit words from a single (non-incrementing) target address via MEM-AP mode 3 (e.g. draining a FIFO)

name: mem_read_16
description: Reads a block of 16-bit half-words from target memory via the MEM-AP (half-word CSW mode)

name: mem_read_8
description: Reads a single byte from target memory via the MEM-AP (byte CSW mode)

name: mem_write_32
description: Writes a block of 32-bit words to target memory via the MEM-AP with auto-incrementing TAR

name: mem_write_32_noinc
description: Writes count 32-bit words to a single (non-incrementing) target address via MEM-AP mode 3

name: mem_write_16
description: Writes a block of 16-bit half-words to target memory via the MEM-AP

name: mem_write_8
description: Writes a single byte to target memory via the MEM-AP (byte CSW mode)

name: cortexm_write_dhcsr_word
description: (uncertain) Sets up the MEM-AP and writes one word to DHCSR (0xE000EDF0), e.g. to resume/run the core

name: stlink_send_reply
description: Sends a command reply over EP1-IN; if the target connection was lost it overwrites the reply with status 5 (dp-error/disconnect) first

name: stlink_cmd_set_freq
description: Handles the SWD/JTAG set-frequency command: programs the bit-bang clock delay (swd_set_clock_delay) or returns the configured divisor, then replies

name: stlink_cmd_get_conn_status
description: (uncertain) Replies with a 4-byte status reporting the current AP index and whether a target is connected (status 5 if disconnected)

name: stlink_cmd_rw_dap_reg
description: APIv2 read/write-DAP-register command: performs a DP or AP register read or write (bank/AP selected from the command) and returns the 2-byte status plus 4-byte value

name: stlink_cmd_set_led_ack
description: (uncertain) Sets the status LED blink state (led mode 6) and replies with status 0x80

name: stlink_cmd_get_fw_build
description: Replies with the firmware build/version string (11 bytes copied from 0x08003C33) when the signature marker byte is present, else zero-fills

name: stlink_cmd_get_version
description: GET_VERSION (0xF1)-family handler: assembles the 0x40-byte version reply including the embedded version/ID strings from the signature block

name: stlink_cmd_get_param_block
description: (uncertain) Returns a 0x24-byte parameter/config block (defaults 2000,1,36000,0x12,0xFFFF) for the current command slot, or error 6 if unavailable

name: stlink_cmd_jtag_raw
description: Raw JTAG IR/DR transfer command: dispatches to jtag_shift_short or jtag_shift_ir_dr from the command block and replies with the 2-byte status

name: stlink_cmd_get_caps
description: (uncertain) Returns a 0x30-byte capability/status block (status 0x80, field=10, value 0x800)

name: stlink_cmd_read_trace_buf
description: Reads the SWO/trace capture buffer: on first call sets up the byte count (max 0xBFE), then streams it out in 0x40-byte chunks from DAT_20002F30

name: stlink_cmd_get_rw_status
description: (uncertain) Replies with an 8-byte read/write-status block (status 0x80, field=6)

name: cortexm_run_core
description: Writes DHCSR 0xA05F0000 (debug-enable, run) for the given valid AP slot to resume the core

name: apkey_table_lookup
description: (uncertain) Matches a 4-byte key/id against the registered access-key table (DAT_20002FA8, up to 10 entries) and returns the matching slot in *slot

name: ap_tables_reset
description: Clears the per-slot key table (DAT_20002FA8), counters (DAT_20001138) and the per-AP slot table (DAT_20001358) to their defaults

name: cmd_check_allowed
description: (uncertain) Validates a command against the current AP/connection state and key table; returns 0x80 if allowed, error (0x0E/0x30) otherwise

name: apkey_table_add
description: Registers a key-table entry: stores the 4-byte key and flag at the given slot and clears its counters, bumping the active-entry count

name: apkey_table_remove
description: Removes a key-table entry: clears the slot's key/flag/counters and decrements the active-entry count

name: stlink_cmd_debug_connect
description: APIv2 enter/exit-debug command handler: selects SWD vs JTAG mode (from sub-bytes 0xA3/0xA5/0xA4), connects or disconnects the target and manages key-table slots

name: swd_set_clock_delay
description: Stores the bit-bang SWD/JTAG clock half-period busy-loop count (DAT_200014D0) used to set the interface frequency

name: swd_init_gpio
description: Configures GPIO for bit-bang SWD: SWCLK (PB13), SWDIO (PB14) and the direction/enable pins on GPIOA/GPIOB

name: jtag_init_gpio
description: Configures GPIO for JTAG/alternate mode (TCK/TMS/TDI/TDO on GPIOB) and drives the nRST/enable lines via target_drive_nrst

name: swd_bitbang_request_fast
description: Bit-bangs an 8-bit SWD request on SWCLK/SWDIO (no inter-bit delay) then reads the 3-bit turnaround/ack from SWDIO (PB12)

name: swd_bitbang_send_request
description: Bit-bangs an 8-bit SWD request on SWCLK/SWDIO with the configured clock delay and reads the 3-bit ack

name: swd_bitbang_read_word
description: Bit-bangs an SWD data-phase read of a 32-bit word plus parity, handling WAIT retries, ack decode, parity check and auto-reconnect

name: swd_bitbang_write_word
description: Bit-bangs an SWD data-phase write of a 32-bit word plus parity, handling WAIT retries, ack decode and auto-reconnect

name: swd_bb_write_word
description: Bit-bang a 32-bit value plus even parity on SWDIO (PB14) with SWCLK (PB13); fast path when DAT_200014d0==0, delayed path otherwise. Used as the data phase of raw SWD write sequences.

name: swd_read_access
description: Core SWD read: shift 8-bit request out, read 3-bit ACK, on OK read 32 data bits+parity into *param_2 and verify parity; retries on WAIT(2) up to 100. Returns 0=OK,1=WAIT,2=FAULT,3=noack,4=parity.

name: swd_read_reg
description: Select DP(0)/AP(1) read-request byte from table (DAT_200014c0 / DAT_200014d4), perform swd_read_access, map status into 0x10/0x20 range; issues abort on WAIT.

name: swd_write_access
description: Core SWD write: shift 8-bit request, read 3-bit ACK, on OK shift 32 data bits+parity (param_2). Returns 0=OK,1=WAIT,2=FAULT,3=noack.

name: swd_write_reg
description: Select DP(0)/AP(1) write-request byte from table (DAT_200014c4 / DAT_200014d8), perform swd_write_access, map status into 0x18/0x28 range.

name: swd_send_line_reset_clocks
description: Drive SWDIO high and issue 53 SWCLK cycles (>50 = SWD line reset).

name: swd_line_reset_idle
description: Line-reset clocks (swd_send_line_reset_clocks) followed by 2 idle clocks with SWDIO low.

name: swd_read_reg_retry
description: (uncertain) Read a DP register (DAT_200014c3) via swd_read_access, retry up to 3 times, return status+0x10.

name: swd_send_switch_sequence
description: Line reset, then shift a 16-bit magic (param_1, e.g. 0xE79E JTAG-to-SWD) LSB-first, then idle clocks.

name: swd_read_idcode
description: SWD attach: optional GPIO/clock re-init, send switch sequence 0xE79E, read DPIDR via swd_read_access, return status+8.

name: swd_bb_write_byte
description: Bit-bang 8 bits of param_1 LSB-first on SWDIO with SWCLK and inter-bit delay (DAT_200014d0).

name: swd_write_word_txn
description: (uncertain) Line-reset idle, write one 32-bit word (swd_bb_write_word) then read back/ack (swd_read_access); one word of a write transaction.

name: swd_write_idle_word
description: Line-reset idle then write an all-ones (0xFFFFFFFF) word via swd_bb_write_word.

name: swd_write_word_block
description: (uncertain) Loop writing an array of 32-bit words via swd_write_word_txn, recording success count and terminator offsets; builds a 0x80 status header.

name: swd_send_auth_key
description: (uncertain) Send an 18-byte constant key (0xF392FFFF 0x2D956209 ...) byte-by-byte via swd_bb_write_byte, then idle clocks; part of a target unlock/auth handshake.

name: swd_enter_special_sequence
description: (uncertain) Mode-1 special enter: GPIO re-init then send 0xFF 0xBA 0xBB 0xBB 0x33, the auth key, and 0x1A; sets DAT_200014c8=1.

name: swd_connect
description: Full SWD connect/HW config: SWD write, optional dormant/switch bytes, EXTI/GPIOA config, DMA (DAT_40020058) and timer setup for the bit-bang transport.

name: jtag_set_frequency
description: SWD/JTAG SET_FREQ: map a frequency code (2..0x100) to an SPI baud-prescaler index into DAT_200012a0 and re-init the SPI/DMA transport; returns 0x80.

name: jtag_spi_dma_init
description: Initialise JTAG transport: configure SPI1 (0x40013000) and SPI2 (0x40003800) and the three DMA1 channels (0x4002001C/30/58) with the DAT_200012a0 prescaler.

name: jtag_reverse_bits
description: Byte/bit-reverse a 32-bit word using the 256-entry reverse table at DAT_08008BFC, reordering bytes [0,2,3,1] for SPI MSB-first shifting.

name: jtag_spi_dma_transfer
description: Set up and trigger a JTAG shift over SPI1/SPI2 using DMA (TMS/TDI/TDO buffers), then wait for completion; returns 0x80 or 3 on timeout.

name: jtag_shift_idcode
description: Move the TAP to a state then shift DR/IR via DMA to read an IDCODE-like value; selects buffer by param_2 (1=0x1F IR).

name: jtag_write_dr
description: (uncertain) Build a bit-reversed DR payload from param_2 and shift it via jtag_spi_dma_transfer; param_1 selects 0x20/0x24 register.

name: jtag_tap_goto_state
description: Drive the JTAG TAP to a target state by shifting a TMS pattern (built from tables DAT_08008BEC) over SPI+DMA; caches last state in DAT_200012A2.

name: jtag_run_test_poll
description: (uncertain) Move to a state and poll via sub_0800B4D0 up to 100 times; returns packed status bytes. Likely a DP read / run-test-idle poll.

name: jtag_spi_xfer_byte
description: Full-duplex SPI byte exchange (SPI2 DR 0x4000380C out, SPI1 DR 0x4001300C) gated on the SPI status register *DAT_20001304; returns received byte and 0x80/2.

name: jtag_detect_tap
description: (uncertain) TAP detection/sync: exchange 0xC0/0x00 bytes, decode the returned pattern to select IR config (DAT_20001308/DAT_20001294); returns status.

name: jtag_config_pin_speed
description: Configure GPIOA/GPIOB output speed for the JTAG pins based on the frequency index DAT_200012A0; returns packed GPIO config words.

name: jtag_init_pins
description: Configure GPIOB JTAG pins and issue initial TCK pulses (sub_08004B06) to reset the TAP; param_1==1 adds extra clocks.

name: jtag_deinit_pins
description: Release JTAG GPIO pins back to inputs/analog and issue a final TCK pulse (used on disconnect).

name: jtag_connect
description: JTAG enter: enable clocks/GPIO, init pins, SPI+DMA init, reset TAP and read IR/IDCODE; returns status byte.

name: jtag_disconnect
description: JTAG exit: deinit pins, disable SPI1/SPI2 and the DMA channels, and turn off the related peripheral clocks.

name: anticlone_is_active
description: Return the anti-clone active flag DAT_200030B0.

name: anticlone_verify_signature
description: Anti-clone check: AES-128 encrypt {flash size + chip UID} with key 'What are you doi' and compare to the 16-byte signature at 0x08003C00; set DAT_200030B1 on mismatch.

name: anticlone_reflash_signature
description: (uncertain) Unlock flash, erase the signature page at 0x08003C00 and reprogram it plus ~0xF7 words copied from 0x0801F824 (brick/restore of the anti-clone block).

name: anticlone_start
description: Begin anti-clone monitoring: clear counters (DAT_200030B2/B4), set active flag DAT_200030B0=1 and snapshot the timer (DAT_200030B8).

name: anticlone_init
description: Reset anti-clone state (DAT_200030B0=0, DAT_200030B1=0) and run the signature verification.

name: anticlone_background_write
description: Anti-clone background task: while active, periodically program flash bytes into 0x0801F400 pacing by elapsed timer ticks; sets fault flag on timeout.

name: debug_read_core_status
description: Read Cortex-M DHCSR (0xE000EDF0) and decode S_RESET/S_HALT/S_SLEEP/S_LOCKUP bits into *param_1 (1..4); returns 0x80.

name: debug_poll_reset
description: Poll debug_read_core_status twice looking for a reset-state transition; returns 1 when detected.

name: jtag_spi_reset_pulse
description: (uncertain) Pulse peripheral-clock mask 1 (AFIO) on then off via sub_0800B85C; a reset/toggle helper.

name: GPIO_Init
description: ST StdPeriph GPIO_Init: program CRL/CRH of the port from the init struct (pin mask + mode/speed nibble), handling pull-up(0x48)/pull-down(0x28) via BSRR/BRR.

name: GPIO_ReadInputDataBit
description: ST StdPeriph GPIO_ReadInputDataBit: return nonzero if the IDR bit (param_2) of the port is set.

name: GPIO_SetBits
description: ST StdPeriph GPIO_SetBits: write param_2 to the port BSRR (offset 0x10).

name: GPIO_ResetBits
description: ST StdPeriph GPIO_ResetBits: write param_2 to the port BRR (offset 0x14).

name: GPIO_WriteBit
description: ST StdPeriph GPIO_WriteBit: set pins via BSRR when param_3!=0 else clear via BRR.

name: GPIO_PinRemapConfig
description: ST StdPeriph GPIO_PinRemapConfig: read-modify-write AFIO_MAPR for the encoded remap field in param_1, enabling when param_2!=0.

name: adc_init_measure
description: Configure ADC1 (0x40012400): set channel/sample time, run calibration, start conversion and store the result in DAT_200030EC (target-voltage sampling).

name: set_msp_if_privileged
description: If the core is in a privileged mode, set the Main Stack Pointer to param_1.

name: nop_function
description: Empty function (returns immediately); likely an inlined barrier/placeholder.

name: select_vector_table
description: Select application vs. loader vector table by the magic 0x47A53C15 at 0x08000100; set DAT_20001504/DAT_20001508 base pointers. Returns 0 if app present.

name: check_app_valid
description: Like select_vector_table but also tests a validity bit of the selected table[1]; returns 1 if the app image is marked valid.

name: stlink_set_mode
description: Map a requested mode (0/1/2/0x13) to the current-mode byte DAT_2000152B (0/5/6/7) reported by GET_CURRENT_MODE; returns 0x80, or 6 on unknown.

name: adc_check_voltage
description: Trigger an ADC1 conversion, wait, read it and return 1 when the sample exceeds 0x400 (target-present/voltage threshold).

name: util_time_diff
description: Return param_2 - param_1 (elapsed-tick / pointer difference helper).

name: timer_delay_ticks
description: Busy-wait until the free-running counter (sub_0800BEB8) advances by param_1 ticks.

name: __scatterload_zeroinit
description: ARM C runtime scatter-load ZI handler: walk {size,addr} table entries and zero-fill each region.

name: led_set_result
description: Store the last command result byte (0x80=OK) in DAT_2000152C, consumed by the LED blink IRQ.

name: led_get_result
description: Return the last command result byte DAT_2000152C (read by APP_TIM1_UP_IRQHandler).

name: led_tim1_init
description: Initialise TIM1 (0x40012C00) in PWM mode driving the status LED on PA9 (TIM1 CH2).

name: led_set_mode
description: Status-LED/TIM1 control state machine: reconfigure PA9 and TIM1 channels/period for the requested blink pattern (param_1 0..6).

name: led_blink_activity
description: Trigger the default LED activity blink (led_set_mode(6,0xB4,7)); called on each command.

name: __aeabi_memclr
description: Zero-fill param_2 bytes ending at param_1+param_2 with word/halfword/byte alignment handling (runtime memclr).

name: stlink_dispatch_command
description: Main ST-Link command dispatcher: parse 16-byte EP2-OUT command blocks for all F1/F2/F3/F4 subcommands (version, debug read/write mem/reg, run/halt/step, SWIM/JTAG/SWD ops, trace), drive the target and stage EP1-IN replies and bulk transfers.

name: stlink_cmd_process
description: Main ST-Link command dispatcher: handles top-level F1-F8/FA/FD commands and, for F2(DEBUG)/F4(SWIM), switches on the subcommand byte to run RW_MEM/RW_REG/RW_DEBUGREG/READALLREGS/enter-mode/freq/trace handlers; reads 16-byte command from per-channel buffer, drives reply. param_1 = command slot (0 = USB EP2 bulk path).

name: stlink_cmd_send_reply
description: Queue reply payload for a command slot: for slot 0 copies to EP1 IN PMA (sub_0800C600) and arms EP1 TX, sets per-slot reply state (3 if last fragment else 2).

name: stlink_cmd_set_status_busy
description: Set per-slot reply state = 1 (more data expected) and, for slot 0, re-arm EP0R control endpoint.

name: stlink_cmd_set_status_idle
description: Set per-slot reply state = 0 (idle/done) and, for slot 0, re-arm EP0R control endpoint.

name: stlink_cmd_is_first_block
description: Return 1 when this is the first block of a multi-block transfer (slot 0 and reply state == 0), else 0.

name: stlink_cmd_reset_status
description: Reset slot-0 reply state to 0.

name: stlink_cmd_reply_unknown
description: Build and send the unknown/invalid-command status reply (status byte 0x42) for the given slot.

name: __aeabi_memcpy
description: Keil ARMCC optimized word-aligned memcpy runtime helper (handles misaligned head/tail, 16/8-byte unrolled body).

name: __aeabi_memset
description: Keil ARMCC memset/fill runtime helper: fills n bytes ending at dst+len with byte value, writing backwards with word/halfword unrolling.

name: swim_dma_init
description: Configure DMA1 channels tied to TIM2/TIM4 for SWIM bit-stream transfer (capture-in buffer DAT_200011b8, pattern-out buffers); programs 3 channels at 0x40020008/0058/0080.

name: swim_init
description: Enter/initialize SWIM interface: set up GPIOB SWIM pin, TIM2+TIM4 (sub_0800CD2A channels), DMA (swim_dma_init), EXTI/NVIC, SCB_SHPR3 priority, and install initial state handler pointer DAT_2000121c.

name: swim_state_read_start
description: (uncertain) SWIM state handler: begin a target read-block operation; probe target (sub_0800938A/sub_0800AB80), arm TIM2/TIM4 + DMA input capture into 0x20001230, advance state pointer.

name: swim_state_write_start
description: (uncertain) SWIM state handler: begin writing a data block; set up out-pattern buffer (sub_0800A800) and send first header byte (sub_0800A708), advance state pointer.

name: swim_state_read_prep
description: (uncertain) SWIM state handler: prepare next read byte; disable IRQ pattern, if first index arm DMA capture into DAT_200011b8 else send next byte, advance state pointer.

name: swim_read_bits
description: (uncertain) SWIM bit-level receive: busy-wait on per-bit capture timers (DAT_200011bc..ca), decode 8 data bits + parity into *param_1, compare against expected, drive ACK/NACK resend via TIM2/TIM4/DMA; returns SWIM status byte.

name: swim_state_read_loop
description: (uncertain) SWIM state handler: read next byte via swim_read_bits, advance byte index DAT_200011d8, handle block/page boundaries and completion, update state pointer and status.

name: swim_state_write_block
description: (uncertain) SWIM state handler: start writing next block; arm TIM2/TIM4+capture, set up out buffer DAT_20001268, send byte, advance state pointer.

name: swim_state_write_wait
description: (uncertain) SWIM state handler: wait for write ACK; on timeout set error status, else swap double buffers and send next byte, advance state pointer.

name: swim_state_write_resync
description: (uncertain) SWIM state handler: re-arm TIM2/TIM4 and send next write byte (from source buffer or pattern table), advance state pointer.

name: swim_state_write_next
description: (uncertain) SWIM state handler: on write ACK, swap buffers and emit next byte / decrement repeat count, advance state pointer; on timeout set error.

name: swim_state_write_second
